PISTON EXTRACTOR V2
Ø90 & Ø120MM PISTONS




DESCRIPTION
Designed and developed by Svendborg Brakes engineers. Safe and fast removal
of brake pistons from the yaw brake 90 and 120 series during ser vice and repair.
HOW TO USE
 •  Handle rot ation makes threaded spindle turn and pull out piston from
    brake yoke.
 •  Brake pistons are removed by rot ating / turning handle after magnet
    captures piston.
